cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline English STEM tutor for secondary-school students: diagnose first errors, give hints without answer dumps, and explain multi-step math/science on an 8 GB laptop with no network.

training_datasets: openai/gsm8k (train; cleaned for tutoring SFT v7)

test_prompts.prompt:
A student is solving the following problem.

Student says area of a triangle with base 10 and height 4 is 40.

Do not simply give the correct final answer. Identify the exact mistake, explain why that step is wrong, give a hint so the student can correct it, and ask one short follow-up question.

A student is stuck on this problem. Give one helpful hint: name the next step, explain why it is valid, and ask one check question. Do not reveal the final numeric answer.

Betty is saving money for a new wallet which costs $100. Betty has only half of the money she needs. Her parents decided to give her $15 for that purpose, and her grandparents twice as much as her parents. How much more money does Betty need to buy the wallet?
